lines.text: Hungry Jesus finds only leaves on a fig tree and says, "May no one ever eat of your fruit again."
In the temple courts, Jesus overturns the tables of the tax collectors and the seats of those selling doves.
Jesus says God's house will be a house of prayer for all nations, but they made it a den of robbers.
